sermon.title: Hearing and Seeing 06/09/2019
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: A message on ears that hear and eyes that see. Many hear without understanding, and God hardens some hearts, as with Pharaoh, to make His name known. By contrast Peter, John’s disciples, Philip and Nathanael heard Jesus and followed. Pray for open ears and a soft heart.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: He names the prophet in 1 Kings 22 as “Micah”; it is Micaiah. His words kept.

faqs.question: What were the plagues?
faqs.answer: Ten, from blood to the firstborn.

faqs.question: Why no fish all night?
faqs.answer: Maybe Jesus didn’t want them to catch any.

faqs.question: Did Peter have pride?
faqs.answer: He knew the place, but obeyed.

faqs.question: What does he pray for?
faqs.answer: Eyes that see, ears that hear.
